mechanic: Real Tetris on a 10-column, 20-row board with seven falling tetrominoes, movement, rotation, soft/hard drop, a ghost piece and next-piece preview. Filling horizontal rows clears them and pauses the game for one multiple-choice question per cleared row, including multi-row clears. A correct answer banks 100 points for that row; an incorrect answer banks nothing, but the row stays cleared. Feedback stays visible until Continue. After all questions for a clear are answered, play resumes; a round completes at 5 or more cleared rows, loses when the stack blocks a new piece, or ends as a draw through Finish. Pausing or leaving the tab stops gravity. Play again resets the board and scores but continues the question cursor.
questionCountNote: 50 unique questions per level. A round only ever moves forward through them: losing, answering wrong, or pressing Play again continues at the next unseen question, so the pool must outlast many rounds.
distractorRules: Wrong options must be the same kind of thing as the right one — same units, same part of speech, same level of detail, similar length. No option may be identifiable by its shape or position; each must be a mistake somebody at this level would actually make.
